packaging: select libc++ for Clang toolchain builds
dcbb3fb476b4d57c4c7e5770f1ed55d43f6f6330	2026-09-03T21:24:51+08:00	packaging: select libc++ for Clang toolchain builds

diff --git a/packaging/icu.spec b/packaging/icu.spec
index 4419a6c..870211f 100644
--- a/packaging/icu.spec
+++ b/packaging/icu.spec
@@ -5,6 +5,12 @@
 
 %define tzdata_version 2025b
 
+%if %{defined _toolchain}
+%if %{toolchain_is clang}
+%define build_with_libcxx 1
+%endif
+%endif
+
 Name:      icu
 Version:   78.1
 Release:   1
@@ -24,6 +30,10 @@ Source1001: icu.manifest
 
 BuildRequires: autoconf
 BuildRequires: pkgconfig(python3)
+%if 0%{?build_with_libcxx}
+BuildRequires: libc++-devel
+BuildRequires: libc++abi-devel
+%endif
 
 %description
 Tools and utilities for developing with icu.
@@ -74,6 +84,10 @@ cp %{SOURCE1} ./source/tools/tzcode
 %build
 export CFLAGS="$CFLAGS -D_TIZEN_FEATURE_ -fPIC"
 export CXXFLAGS="$CXXFLAGS -D_TIZEN_FEATURE_ -fPIC"
+%if 0%{?build_with_libcxx}
+export CXXFLAGS="$CXXFLAGS -stdlib=libc++"
+export LDFLAGS="$LDFLAGS -stdlib=libc++ -Wl,--no-as-needed -lc++abi -Wl,--as-needed"
+%endif
 export LINKFLAGS=" -pie"
 export LANG=C.UTF-8

    packaging: select libc++ for Clang toolchain builds
    
    Use libc++ only when the Base Toolchain selector resolves to Clang.
    Keep GCC and non-toolchain builds on their existing standard library.
    
    在 Base Toolchain 选择 Clang 时使用 libc++；GCC 与非工具链构建保持原行为。

 1 file changed, 14 insertions(+)
